title: GPU LDPC belief-propagation batch decode kernel
description:
## Goal

LDPC belief-propagation batch decode kernel on gfx1030 covering
DVB-T2 n=64800 today; designed for per-`i_LS` 5G NR shift tables so
the same kernel parameterises both standards (BG1 / BG2 in Phase E
`23d3525f`).

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages) within epic `gf2-sim`
(`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §6 (multi-arch dispatch,
shared kernel binary across BG / lifting set); §8 (OOM signalled,
not dispatched, by this stage); §10 (f32 messages). Wave B.2
fan-out from `36075e4c`. May absorb in-scope tasks from
`epic:hip-gpu-prototype` (`806eb14e`).

Algorithm baselines: BP MinSum / Normalized-MinSum(α) / SumProduct,
matching the CPU `LdpcDecoder` configuration knobs from
`gf2_coding::ldpc::core::DecoderConfig`. Variable-node and
check-node updates run in parallel across the batch; per-iteration
synchronisation via shared memory; deterministic message ordering
(no atomic-add reductions on f32; per-edge ordered accumulation
into a per-edge scratch followed by an ordered reduction).

**AMENDMENT 2026-06-09 (user-approved, apples-to-apples perf baseline).**
The `parallelism-pays` gate compares **decode-stage throughput vs
decode-stage throughput**, NOT GPU-decode vs CPU-full-frame. The
`c0b1702d` (1.6216 fps single-thread) and `3fcb7025` (21.44 fps
24-thread) receipts are FULL-FRAME numbers (encode + interleave +
map + AWGN + demap + decode); using them as the divisor for a
decode-only kernel is category-confused and too lenient (full-frame
fps < decode-only fps, inflating the apparent speedup) — the same
defect that was user-amended on `f6004add`. The gate divisor is the
**CPU `LdpcDecoder` decode stage measured in isolation** (the same
DVB-T2 r1/2 16-QAM Normal config, SumProduct, early-termination on,
at the canonical Es/N0 = 6.5 dB), at single-thread and 24-thread.
Record the full-frame numbers in the receipt for context, but gate
on decode-vs-decode.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/kernels/ldpc_bp.hip`:
   - Configurable for DVB-T2 (n=64800, m=32400) and 5G NR (BG1 / BG2
     with per-`i_LS` shift tables consumed as a uniform-buffer
     parameter).
   - Implements MinSum, NormalizedMinSum(α), SumProduct per
     `DecoderConfig` algorithm enum.
   - Maximum BP iterations parameterised; early termination via
     parity-check after each iteration.
   - Hard-decision output written to a device buffer.
2. `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/src/launch_ldpc_bp.rs`:
   - `launch_ldpc_bp(stream, base_graph, shift_table, llrs, ...,
     algorithm, max_iters)`.
3. `crates/gf2-sim/src/gpu/ldpc_bp.rs` (under `--features hip`):
   - `pub struct GpuLdpcBp { config: DecoderConfig, base_graph: H }`
     implementing `Stage<LlrBatch, HardDecisionBatch>`.
   - `cpu_fallback()` returns CPU `gf2_coding::ldpc::core::LdpcDecoder`.
4. Byte-identity test (under `--features hip`) in
   `tests/gpu_ldpc_byte_identity.rs`:
   - For DVB-T2 r1/2 16-QAM, fixed seed, 200 frames at three SNRs:
     GPU hard-decision output equal to CPU `LdpcDecoder` output
     bit-for-bit.
5. Parallelism-pays receipt entry in
   `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/parallelism-receipts.md` (apples-to-apples,
   decode-vs-decode per the amendment above):
   - GPU LDPC BP decode throughput vs **single-thread CPU
     `LdpcDecoder` decode-stage** throughput (≥ 10×).
   - GPU LDPC BP decode throughput vs **CPU-24-thread `LdpcDecoder`
     decode-stage** throughput (≥ 3×) — this is the gate that
     actually decides whether adding the GPU helps. Resolves audit C2.
   - Record the full-frame `c0b1702d`/`3fcb7025` numbers (1.6216 fps /
     21.44 fps) for context only; they are NOT the gate divisor.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] GPU LDPC BP hard-decision output matches CPU `LdpcDecoder`
  bit-for-bit for DVB-T2 r1/2 16-QAM at fixed seed and 200 frames
  across MinSum, NormalizedMinSum(0.75), SumProduct.
- [hard] `parallelism-pays` gate (apples-to-apples, decode-vs-decode
  per the 2026-06-09 amendment): receipt records
  - GPU decode throughput ≥ 10× single-thread CPU `LdpcDecoder`
    decode-stage throughput (measured in isolation, same config)
  - **AND** GPU decode throughput ≥ 3× CPU-24-thread `LdpcDecoder`
    decode-stage throughput. The 3× CPU-24-thread bar is the
    measurement that proves the GPU is worth the integration cost.
  - The full-frame `c0b1702d`/`3fcb7025` baselines are recorded for
    context only, NOT used as the gate divisor.
- [hard] Per-`i_LS` shift table parameterisation in place (kernel
  accepts the table at launch time) so Phase E `23d3525f` can
  re-use the same kernel for 5G NR.
- [hard] `cpu_fallback()` returns the CPU decoder; integration
  verified by Phase B `ed575f15`.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, `parallelism-pays` gates green.

## Non-goals

- No 5G NR-specific tuning here (Phase E `23d3525f` does that).
- No multi-GPU dispatch (epic non-goal).
- No floating-point f16 / mixed-precision (deferred per design-doc
  §10).
